history.summary: CSV TOWN FLAG: the temple is at Khandoli, not Giridih town - documented with the corrected town. Khandoli Shiv Mandir is a Shiva temple in the Khandoli tourist area, about 10 km northeast of Giridih town (per G2Rail), which centres on the Khandoli reservoir, park and a 600-ft hillock with a watch tower. Wanderlog notes that Khandoli Park has a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva. UNVERIFIED: the temple's age, architecture and dedicated history are not reliably documented, and there are several unrelated 'Shiv Mandir' listings in Giridih town - the CSV name ties this record to the Khandoli one. No verified image of the temple itself was found after targeted searching - media is empty by design. Coordinates are approximate (Khandoli Park area).

name: Khandoli Shiv Mandir
town: Khandoli (CSV town 'Giridih' is WRONG - the temple is at the Khandoli tourist spot, ~10 km northeast of Giridih town)
town_description: Khandoli is a tourist spot in Giridih district, Jharkhand, about 10 km northeast of Giridih town, built around the Khandoli reservoir. The site offers boating, kayaking, rock-climbing and parasailing, bird watching, elephant and camel safaris, and a watch tower on a 600-ft hillock with panoramic views. Khandoli village falls in Bengabad block of the district.
